THE SUPERVISOR'S 'EXHAUSTED SAME-CHARTER WORK' GUARD IS DEAD CODE, BECAUSE jq's // OPERATOR TREATS LITERAL false AS EMPTY. Read at .github/workflows/factory-supervisor.yml:277 and reproduced locally with jq 1.7 this run: the guard evaluates `jq -r '.continue_recommended // true' <<<"$raw"` and compares the result to the string false, but `echo '{"continue_recommended":false}' | jq -r '.continue_recommended // true'` prints `true`, because jq's alternative operator falls through on false as well as on null. The guard can therefore NEVER fire, and any team whose lab/frontier/<team>.json says continue_recommended:false is re-dispatched forever. Observed live: frontier-counter-label-integrity was dispatched at 06:35Z (run 38862093221, cancelled) and again at 07:47Z (run 38869446783) while its accepted branch state already read charter_version 1, cycle_status TERMINATE, continue_recommended false -- producing at least nine no-change verification cycles and eight producer-authored audit placement copies. The identical pattern is on line 230 for the CORE lanes' .continue_recommended check, so a core lane can also be re-dispatched after it declares itself exhausted. .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from a lane, a team or the director. ROUTE-AROUND, and this is the standing rule rather than a one-off fix: the portfolio .status field is the ONLY reliable stop, because the dispatch query at line 261 is `select(.status=="RUN")`, a plain string comparison the jq defect does not touch. Set a discharged or exhausted team's status to TERMINATED; do not rely on continue_recommended, do not rely on a blocker file, and do not re-dispatch it. Intended upstream fix for the control-plane maintainer: test the field with `jq -r 'if .continue_recommended == false then "false" else "true" end'` (or `.continue_recommended | tostring`), never with //.

SET-IDENTITY CLAIMS ABOUT ACCEPTED EVIDENCE MUST BE VERIFIED AS SET RELATIONS, NEVER BY MATCHING CARDINALITIES. Verified this repair round (audit A-1 against director run 38906250297): reports/director/RUN_38906250297.md section 3 asserted, inside the table it heads 'every number recomputed this run from the accepted mount', that 'the 16 absent rows are exactly the 16 UNBACKED, supported=false rows'. Independent recomputation over the accepted artifact results/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/LABEL_HALF.json bundles[*].rows (n=65 = 25 de + 15 fr + 25 it) on (primary_defect_class, counter_evidence_verified, supported) gives ('OFF-DOMAIN', true, false) 38, ('SUPPORTED', true, true) 5, ('UNBACKED', None/absent, false) 16, ('UNBACKED', true, false) 6. So {counter_evidence_verified absent} = 16 while {primary_defect_class = UNBACKED AND supported = false} = 22: the absent set is a PROPER SUBSET, and the sentence also contradicted its own cell (which correctly reports UNBACKED 22). THE CORRECT STATEMENT, which is the correction of record: all 16 absent-verified rows are UNBACKED with supported=false, reason_code 'evidence_absent' and empty cited_evidence, at counter_uncertainty 0.95-1.0 (per bundle de 1 / fr 4 / it 11, the same partition the accepted canvas lock amber 1/4/11 measures); UNBACKED totals 22, and the other 6 carry counter_evidence_verified=true with 52-287 cited quotes and fail for CONTENT reasons instead (reason_code 'no_domain_anchor' 2, 'no_intent_marker' 4; counter_uncertainty 0.25-0.65). WHY IT IS NOT COSMETIC: the 16 are the evidence-plumbing class the accepted render fix addressed; the 6 are evidence-present-but-insufficient and need classifier work. Collapsing them implies every UNBACKED row is a missing-evidence row and hides the distinction on which product's rebuild-or-decline decision turns. STANDING RULE: before writing 'exactly', 'identical to' or 'all of the' between two counted sets of accepted rows, compute the intersection and both differences, never the two counts; a matching sub-count inside a larger count proves containment at best, never identity; and state WHICH field defines each set (bundle, row language, decision id) because per-bundle and per-row language partitions of the same 16 rows differ. PROVENANCE AND SUPERSESSION: RUN_38906250297.md is claim-bearing history and is NOT edited by the director (never overwrite a claim-bearing output; this repair round's declared scope is state/** plus its own report), so that clause is SUPERSEDED as of director run 38915705490 and is NOT claimable. The correction of record is this entry plus reports/director/RUN_38915705490.md sections 2-3, which govern wherever the two reports differ.
